products.name: Relevance AI
products.note: No-code AI workforce; agent teams; task automation; APAC data residency

profile_text.body:
Relevance AI is a platform that allows businesses to build and deploy specialist AI agents for functions such as sales, customer success, marketing, and human resources. The company describes itself as enabling organizations to run millions of daily tasks through optimized agents operating on a single platform, and it offers a no-code approach to constructing these agent teams.

The platform's primary product, also called Relevance AI, sits in the coding and developer tools category and supports agent team configurations, task automation, and APAC data residency. Rob Giglio is quoted on the company's site describing the platform as a way for sellers and customer success representatives to remain more engaged with customers by offloading work to AI.
